event_description: Maintenance team dispatched to inspect conveyor motor
Replacement motor installed and tested
Line 3 conveyor restored to full operation
Contacted supplier for expedited shipment
Partial shipment received stamping line resumed at reduced rate
Full stock replenished stamping line back to normal capacity
Quality team quarantined affected weld batch
Root cause identified as miscalibrated welding robot and recalibrated
Tooling replaced and press validated for production
Supervisor reallocated staff from Line 4 to cover shortage
Temporary agency workers requested for remainder of week
Temporary staff onboarded and second shift fully staffed; incident closed
Backup generators engaged for critical systems
Utility power restored and full production resumed
Changeover completed and line restarted
Safety training session completed for new hires
Operators cleared to resume line work
Preventive maintenance completed and robots recalibrated
Engineering team investigating recurring motor fault
Root cause analysis ongoing with vibration sensors installed for monitoring
Vibration data confirmed bearing wear; motor bearing replaced and Line 3 restored
